description: Android custom View class 'TouchDisplayView' that visualizes multi-touch events and their history, including handling touch pointers, drawing circles representing touches, and managing touch data with object pooling.

classes.name: TouchDisplayView
classes.description: Custom Android View for displaying multi-touch points and their history, handling touch events, drawing circles, and managing touch data.

classes.name: TouchHistory
classes.description: Data class representing a touch point's current state, pressure, label, and historical positions, with object pooling for reuse.

methods.name: obtain
methods.description: Factory method to get a TouchHistory object from the pool or create a new one, initializing it with position and pressure.

methods.name: setTouch
methods.description: Sets the current position and pressure of the touch.

methods.name: recycle
methods.description: Releases the TouchHistory object back to the pool and resets its state.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a historical position to the touch's history buffer.

methods.name: initialisePaint
methods.description: Initializes Paint objects and calculates radii based on device density.

methods.name: drawCircle
methods.description: Draws a circle representing a touch point and its history on the canvas.
